The held FR text of EO 11813 (39 FR 36317, Oct. 7, 1974) says in Sec. 4 that Executive Order No. 11202 of March 5, 1965 is hereby revoked and in Sec. 5 that the order is effective immediately, an express whole-order revocation; the held 5 U.S.C. 3301 note (theophilus-sources) agrees. The cruden number search found no other held text naming EO 11202 and no earlier end, so the first end is 1974-10-07 and status no holds.
